extractions.label: xp_movable_count_6_5
extractions.expression: (() => { const g = idleon.getAttr("RoyalG"); let count = 0; for (let w = 0; w < 8; w++) { const roles = g[6+2*w] || []; const maps = g[7+2*w] || []; for (let u = 0; u < roles.length; u++) if (Number(roles[u]) === 5 && Number(maps[u]) === 6) count++; } return count; })()
